privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What {site} knows about you, why, and how to take back control of it.

summary.title: In short
summary.pseudo: A nickname is all you need. Email and password are optional and only help you get your lists back on another device.
summary.noTracking: No ads, no reselling, no third-party trackers. Votes are never shown individually: only the combined ranking is displayed.
summary.selfService: Export and deletion are self-service from “My account”, no need to write to anyone.

pseudo.why: Identifying you to the other participants in a session

credentials.why: Optional — getting your lists back on another device

lists.why: Reusing a selection from one session to the next
lists.kept: Until the account or the list is deleted

groups.why: Inviting the same crew back without typing the code every session
groups.kept: Until the account or the group is deleted, or until you leave it

sessions.why: Running the vote and showing the ranking
sessions.kept: As long as the session exists

votes.why: Working out the ranking — never shown individually
votes.kept: Kept in aggregate, detached from their author when the account is deleted

constraints.why: Optional — flagging in your sessions a restaurant where you can’t eat, without ever saying who
constraints.kept: Until you remove them, or the account is deleted

push.why: Optional — letting you know when a vote starts or a ranking is ready, tab closed, in your language
push.kept: Until “Stop notifying me”, account deletion, or the browser dropping it

guests.why: Letting you use the app without signing up

attempts.why: Stopping a script from guessing invitation codes
attempts.kept: Purged within 24 hours — no IP address is stored

constraints.title: What you can’t eat
constraints.intro: A halal or kosher diet can reveal a religion, gluten-free a health condition: this is sensitive data. Only you declare it, from “My account”, and only if you want to — declaring it means consenting to this use, and one click removes it.
constraints.nobody: Nobody else can read it, not even the host of your sessions.
constraints.countOnly: A session only shows a count per restaurant — “2 participants can’t eat there” —, never who or why. With just two people in a session, that count may be enough to guess: that’s the price of a useful signal.
constraints.noAnalytics: It never goes to the audience measurement tool.
constraints.export: The export includes it, deleting the account erases it.

deletion.title: What happens on deletion
deletion.intro: Deleting an account shouldn’t rewrite other people’s history. In practice:
deletion.erased: The profile, nickname, email, password, lists, dietary constraints and notification subscriptions are deleted for good.
deletion.groups: Groups the account owns disappear for all their members, and the account leaves the ones it had joined.
deletion.votes: Votes already counted in a finished session stay in the ranking, but detached from their author: the other participants see “Deleted participant”.
deletion.sessions: Sessions hosted by the account that are waiting or still voting are deleted: without a host, they can’t reach a result.
deletion.pendingVotes: Votes in an unfinished session are deleted along with the participation.

hosting.title: Who hosts this data
hosting.providers: The database and authentication are run by Supabase, the app is hosted by Vercel, in the region chosen for the project. Both providers only use the data to deliver their service. No one else has access to it.
hosting.push: If you turn on notifications, they go through your browser’s push service (Google for Chrome and Android, Mozilla for Firefox, Apple for Safari). Their content — the session name and the link to open — is end-to-end encrypted: that service carries it without being able to read it.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: The GDPR gives you the right of access, rectification, portability and erasure. The last three are right in the app: you change your nickname from “My account”, the export gives you all of your data as JSON, and deletion is immediate and permanent.
